Streaming chat completion via Azure OpenAI — verifies the azure/ prefix routes correctly and SSE chunks are delivered in the standard OpenAI chat.completion.chunk shape

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.chat_stream(client, "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Count to 3\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"azure/gpt-4\",\"stream\":true,\"temperature\":0}") |> Enum.to_list()
IO.inspect(result)
```
